answer_text: I couldn’t locate a Cato KB article that covers geo-location misreporting (for example Paris showing as Germany in Google) after migrating Paris to Cato. The KB items available discuss Paris PoP IP ranges (for example 159.117.224.0/24) but do not provide a fix for this issue. If you can share details about the traffic path (which PoP is being used) and affected users, I can help determine next steps or escalate.
